messages:
joanne: Opening a docs PR to add a migration checklist for teams moving Private deployments from the legacy mtls-proxy to the new mtls-proxy-v2. Includes example Envoy filter snippets and an SDK snippet for the Go client to switch CA cert endpoints: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1268

joanne: Key items I'm adding: migration steps, rollback guidance, link update from /docs/onprem/proxy -> /docs/onprem/mtls-proxy-v2, minimal envoy filter example, and a short Go+Python SDK snippet for rotating the KMS endpoint.

ryan: Nice. Can you add a short preflight checklist for customers that cannot reach the new control plane during migration? e.g. check DNS CNAMEs, test the TLS chain with `openssl s_client -connect proxy:443 -CAfile ca.pem`, and verify that HSM PIN entry is not required during cert swap.

mike: For the Envoy example, prefer showing a listener-level filter insert instead of global to avoid surprising side effects. Tiny snippet: ```yaml
listeners:
  - name: mtls_in
    address: ...
    filter_chains:
      - filters:
          - name: envoy.filters.network.tcp_proxy
            typed_config: {}
```

mike: Also add a note about backing up `redwood-agent` unit files before editing systemd.
